title: Senior UX Designer
description:
**About the company** 

 :
 




 SiteRecon
 
 is helping enterprise customers in the US to scale their sales teams by automating a key part of the process. We are working with property maintenance contractors and automating property mapping and site visits through our platform, giving back time, speeding up their sales process, and increasing their profitability. 
 





 We are building the next\-generation property intelligence platform and looking for people to help out on our mission to revolutionize how contractor businesses make decisions in North America. 
 





 Our forte lies in using GIS technology to create highly intelligent map data for any piece of land or property required by our customers. We have improved the time taken for a key process from days to hours, now we are building a team to complete the process within minutes using deep learning.
 




**Job description:** 




  






 SiteRecon is looking for a
 
**Sr. Product designer** 

 who is ready to play a technical role while working directly with the founder of the company. Under this role, you will be responsible for
 
**enhancing customer experience by improving the usability \& accessibility of the products.** 




  





**What you will do:** 




  




1. Take high level product ideas from conception through execution, across web and mobile.
 
**We are a small team so you'll work across a wide range of areas \- product strategy, user research, and UX/UI design in particular.**
2. Take joint ownership of metrics and strategy with the product team, and
 
**work collaboratively with engineering and operations to achieve goals** 

 .
3. Set a standard for User Experience which matches the likes of Apple Inc., Airbnb and if possible surpasses it.
 
**Simplicity and minimalism are the words to live by** 

 in our product team.
4. Working closely with the product head to understand the concept and deliver the results as per industry best practices and standards and do iterations on design till approval from the product head.
5. Market research for the industry to get the most relevant or trending design and product experience.
6. Customer research and interviews to create the
 
**detailed customer personas** 

 which will drive our design system and methodology
7. Every design decision should be backed by sound reasoning based on
 
**customer research, user psychology, UX principles and trends and data** 

 (if available).
8. Creating high fidelity prototypes (In Figma) which can be presented directly to the customers to gain valuable feedback before investing in the development.
9. Ability to use analytics tools such as hotjar, Google Analytics, Amplitude and survey tools to understand the engagement of users with the live product and improve designs to boost the product KPIs
10. Working closely with the product development team to deliver best in class
 
**feasible** 

 designs over different versions.
11. Do product testing as a part of UAT before every release to ensure
 
**pixel perfect** 

 delivery, check whether the actual data is not contradicting with the proposed design and the user flows are as easy and complete as imagined during design.
12. Planning concepts for design assets by studying relevant information and materials related to geospatial, AI agents and SiteRecon.
13. Illustrating concepts by designing digital assets for social media, blog and other channels with attention to visual aesthetic, art arrangement, size, type, color layout as per branding practices, size and style.



  





**Required skills \& qualifications:** 




  




1. Bachelor's / Master's degree in design, HCI or equivalent professional experience.
2. At least 5 years of work experience in Product UX design along with at least 2 years experience in conducting user research through interviews,heatmaps and surveys.
3. Entrepreneurship or small startup experience
4. Proficient in design tools like \-
5. Figma
6. Adobe Photoshop/ Illustrator
7. Good knowledge of HTML 5/ CSS3  and CSS frameworks to check for design bugs during release testing
8. Experience with working with usability research tools.
9. An Aptitude \& honed intuition for tasteful visual design details.
10. Ability to research trends in the market for a seamless user experience.
11. A strong awareness of common usability methods \& principles.
12. Excellent communication, presentation, interpersonal \& analytical skills
13. Ability to work methodically \& meet deadlines.



  





**Values that we admire:** 




  




1. **Bias for Action** 

 \- We practice high\-velocity decision\-making, despite encountering ambiguity frequently.
2. **Act Like an Owner** 

 \- We have a strong ownership mentality, because of this, we work smart, hard, and long. Every person on the team has the potential to have a large impact.
3. **Always Be Learning** 

 \- We learn rapidly and eagerly, from different teams within and outside the company. Respectful debate makes our organization stronger.
4. **Empathy, Trust, Candor \-** 

 Being empathetic to our users and each other helps build trust in our community and company and fosters successful decision\-making.

description: Job Title: Frontend Developer Location: Hybrid Job Type: Full\-Time Introduction: We are seeking a highly skilled Frontend Developer who is proficient in React, UI development, and JavaScript technologies, including jQuery. This role will involve close collaboration with product managers and backend developers to deliver seamless API integrations and outstanding user experiences. Translate designs and wireframes into high\-quality code ensuring responsiveness and cross\-platform compatibility. Proficiency in JavaScript and jQuery, with a solid understanding of asynchronous request handling, partial page updates, and AJAX. To Apply: Please send your resume, a cover letter, and a portfolio of relevant projects to \[email address]. Your portfolio should include examples of front\-end development work, particularly projects using React, jQuery, and automated tests you have implemented.

title: Interior Designer
description:
**Company Description** 
 A Business Studio is a trusted partner for premium outsourcing solutions, helping businesses streamline operations and improve efficiency. The company specializes in optimizing processes and driving sustainable growth across diverse industries. By managing operational details, A Business Studio enables clients to focus on their core business goals and strategic priorities. The team emphasizes collaborative partnerships and customized solutions that align with each client’s unique needs. Applicants will join a dynamic environment focused on delivering high\-impact, scalable business support.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Interior Designer will work on\-site in Noida in a full\-time capacity, developing functional and aesthetically pleasing interior spaces for a variety of client projects. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include collaborating with stakeholders to understand project requirements, creating design concepts, and preparing detailed layout plans. The role involves coordinating space planning, selecting materials and finishes, and specifying furniture, fixtures, and equipment (FF\&E) to meet design standards and budget constraints. The Interior Designer will produce or review construction drawings in coordination with architecture and engineering teams, ensuring designs comply with safety codes and regulations. The position also includes site visits, vendor coordination, and participation in design presentations to ensure smooth project execution from concept through completion.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Ability to plan and organize interior layouts, demonstrating strong skills in Space Planning and Interior Design.
* Foundational understanding of Architecture and its integration with interior design projects.
* Proficiency in preparing and interpreting Construction Drawings for interior projects.
* Experience selecting and coordinating FF\&E (Furniture, Fixtures \& Equipment) aligned with design intent and budget.
* Relevant degree or diploma in Interior Design, Architecture, or a closely related field.
* Proficiency in design and drafting software (e.g., AutoCAD, Revit, SketchUp, or similar tools).
* Strong visual communication skills, including the ability to create mood boards, 3D views, and presentations.
* Attention to detail, time management skills, and the ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills for working with clients, vendors, and cross\-functional teams.

title: Senior Network Solution Designer
description:
**Job Description**
 As a Senior Network Solution Designer to join the Access Networks organization. The candidate will be responsible for designing, implementing, and supporting complex enterprise and service‑provider‑grade network infrastructures. The role requires deep technical expertise in routing, switching, network segmentation, L2/L3 services, wireless infrastructure, and architectural design. The candidate must operate effectively both independently and within distributed global teams.
   

  

**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**
* Develop detailed High\-Level and Low\-Level Designs (HLD/LLD) for routing, switching, segmentation, Wi‑Fi, and NAC\-enabled environments
* Design scalable enterprise and service provider network architecture
* Evaluate architecture changes, define resiliency requirements, and ensure alignment to Nokia standards.
* Analyze and resolve complex production network issues while ensuring reliable service operation for both Wired and Wireless network services.
* Administer service requests, execute network changes, and manage escalated incidents or priority incidents end\-to\-end.
* Collaborate with cross\-technology teams to provide timely updates and coordinate incident resolutions.
* Identify root causes of network incidents and develop preventive actions while adhering to change management processes.
* Design and deploy wireless networks and authentication solutions, ensuring compliance with security best practices.
* Act as a L3 escalation point for L2 team members and mentor junior team members while staying updated on industry trends in network security technologies.
* Drive results and foster a strong customer focus in a dynamic, global team environment to maintain SLA compliance.


**Key Skills And Experience**
**You\-Have:**
* Bachelor's degree in Telecommunications, Information Technology, Computer Science, or equivalent with 12\+ years of experience in network services within complex environments
* Deep knowledge in Network Routing, Switching, design/configuration in Local Area Networks.
* Proficiency in authentication protocols like RADIUS, TACACS, and LDAP
* Proficiency in OSPF, ISIS, BGP, VRRP and MPLS network protocols,VPLS, VPRN and VLL services
* Familiarity with ITIL processes and network technologies and Engineer network resilience, redundancy and optimized traffic flows.


**Nice\-To\-Have**
* Knowledge of scripting and automation tools for network management
* Experience in configuration and management of Clearpass \& NAC
* WLAN knowledge specifically with Aruba Access Points and Controllers
* SROS Nokia Service Router Experience


**About Us**
**Advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.**
 Nokia is a global leader in connectivity for the AI era. With expertise across fixed, mobile and transport networks, powered by the innovation of Nokia Bell Labs, we’re advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.
   

  

 Learn more about life at Nokia .

 We act inclusively and respect the uniqueness of people. Our employment decisions are made regardless of race, color, national or ethnic origin, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. We are committed to a culture of inclusion built upon our core value of respect.
   

  

 If you’re interested in this role but don’t meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply. Unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences enrich our teams, and you may be just the right candidate for this or another opportunity.
   

  

 The length of the recruitment process may vary depending on the specific role's requirements. We strive to ensure a smooth and inclusive experience for all candidates. Discover more about the recruitment process at Nokia .
   

  

**About The Team**

* Flexible and hybrid working arrangements to support work–life balance

title: Figma Designer - Noida
description:
What this role pays, in context
   

  

 This listing does not state its pay. UI/UX Designer roles in India currently advertise a median of
 **₹10\.5K a month** 
 .
   

  

 25th pct ₹8\.9K75th pct ₹13\.3K
   

  

 Median of 14 other live UI/UX Designer listings in India on this board that state pay. Roles that do not disclose a salary are excluded rather than counted as zero.
   

  

 Most of this job is the unglamorous middle of design work: taking a half\-formed product idea, sketching the flow, and pushing it through wireframes until the screens make sense to someone opening them for the first time. At MailerMen that happens on a live job board used by candidates and hiring teams, so a decision about a listing layout or a search filter ends up in front of real users rather than in a portfolio deck.
   

  

 This is a full\-time, onsite position based in Noida, working directly with the product and engineering people who build what you design. Expect a fair amount of back and forth. Designs get questioned, simplified and revised before they ship, and you are expected to explain your reasoning as clearly as you present your visuals.
   

  

 We hire at the two to four year mark because the work needs someone past the tutorial stage in Figma: comfortable owning a screen end to end, still curious about how design decisions behave once they meet real traffic.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Create wireframes and user flows.
* Design high\-fidelity web and application interfaces.
* Create interactive prototypes in Figma.
* Develop reusable design components.
* Maintain design systems.
* Design responsive interfaces for desktop, tablet, and mobile.
* Translate product requirements into user\-friendly designs.
* Collaborate with developers during implementation.
* Provide developer\-ready design handoffs.
* Review implemented designs and provide visual feedback.
* Research and apply modern UI/UX design practices.


**Requirements**
* 2\-4 years of professional UI/UX or product design experience.
* Strong hands\-on Figma experience.
* Strong understanding of typography, spacing, layout, and visual hierarchy.
* Experience with wireframing and prototyping.
* Understanding of responsive design.
* Experience creating design systems and reusable components.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Good communication and collaboration skills.

* Exposure to modern product design practices.

description:

**Position Overview**
* Instrument Designer conducts process design and drafting under Principal or Lead Engineer, Lead Designer or Sr Designer supervision mainly for Onshore and power plant facilities.
* The ideal candidate for the position is with Hands\-on experience in Engineering Management Platform and design/drafting tools(AVEVA. E3D AutoCAD etc)


**Key Responsibilities**
* Under Principal or Lead Instrument Engineer and/or Lead Designer or Sr Designer's supervision,
* Conduct Instrument Design and Drafting and 3D Modeling for offshore Oil \& gas facilities
* Develop Instrument Design Database in Engineering Management Platform and design tools such as Aveva, E3D, SP3D, Autocad etc.
* Extract 2D deliverables such as layouts etc from 3D model and issue
* Participation in 30%, 60%, 90% model review and comment closure activities
* Coordinate with other designers/engineers in multi discipline environment to ensure deliverables are issued meeting the schedule and quality requirements

* Minimum 5 years’ experience in the onshore oil and gas industry

* Ability to work with and to communicate effectively with co\-workers and manage multiple priorities.
* Good understanding in English, with good oral and written communication skill
